definitions.explanation: An organ involved in digesting food, such as the stomach and intestines. Together they form the digestive system.

examples.japanese: {胃|い}は{消化|しょうか}{器官|きかん}の{一|ひと}つだ。
examples.english: The stomach is one of the digestive organs.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}、{消化|しょうか}{器官|きかん}の{調子|ちょうし}が{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: Lately my digestive organs have not been in good shape.

examples.japanese: よくかんで{食|た}べることは、{消化|しょうか}{器官|きかん}の{負担|ふたん}を{減|へ}らすことにつながる。
examples.english: Chewing food well helps reduce the burden on the digestive organs.

notes:
Composed of {消化|しょうか} (digestion) + {器官|きかん} (organ). Refers to the organs that process food, including the stomach, intestines, and liver.

USAGE:
- {消化|しょうか}{器官|きかん}に{負担|ふたん}をかける: to put a burden on the digestive organs
- {消化|しょうか}{器官|きかん}が{弱|よわ}い: to have a weak digestive system

RELATED WORDS:
- {消化器|しょうかき}: digestive system — a near-synonym common in medical contexts, as in {消化器|しょうかき}{内科|ないか} (gastroenterology)
- {内臓|ないぞう}: internal organs — the broader category
